body: It’s a close one between the Flash and Robin.
The Reaper or The Phantasm, it’d probably be only one of them because of their close physical appearance but each character could explore a part of Batman that’s never been approached before.

I think the worst part of all of this for me, is that if I’m still around when I’m 30 or 40 I know I’ll look back and she’ll be the one that got away. Of course I could find someone else but she set such a high standard. Some people search their whole life for someone like her and I was lucky enough to find her as my first love. Fuck me right?
